artifact: Artifact JSON filename used for this test.
test_id: Identifier of the test combination in the artifact.
initial_condition: Starting state values, ordered like the model state names.
target: Desired state values, ordered like the model state names.
scenario_name: Name of the selected test scenario.
agent_mode: Mock mode or the language model used for tuning.

seeds.run: Seed identifying this repetition and its seed<value> results folder.
seeds.llm: Seed supplied to the LLM provider for this repetition; null for mock runs.
seeds.simulation: Seed for scenario parameter perturbations, tuning noise and verification noise.
seeds.mock: Seed for mock agent proposals, decisions and synthetic usage; null for real LLM runs.

total_complexity: Manually assigned test difficulty, filled during finalization.
success_rate_1: Finalization: exp(-10 * mean normalized full-window MSE over declared controlled outputs); original success_rate renamed.
success_rate_2: Finalization: fraction of configured fixed targets passed for this verification run, equally weighted; null if a required check is unavailable.

success_rate_2_details.passed_targets: Number of configured target checks that passed for this run.
success_rate_2_details.total_targets: Number of enabled fixed targets; omitted/null limits do not count.
success_rate_2_details.failed_targets: Number of configured checks that failed.
unavailable_targets: Names of checks lacking valid/meaningful verification data; Rate 2 is null if this list is nonempty.
success_rate_2_details.all_targets_passed: Whether every enabled target passed; distinct from partial-target credit and core success.
success_rate_2_details.mse_scope: Mean full-window MSE of declared controlled outputs, not all internal states.
outputs: Controlled output names used for the MSE comparison.
success_rate_2_details.numerically_failed: Whether verification reported divergence, a state-bound violation or an error; such runs fail all configured checks.

<fixed_target_name>.limit: Configured upper limit copied from the artifact's simulation_parameters.fixed_targets.
<fixed_target_name>.measured_value: Final verification value compared with the limit; overshoot is converted from a fraction to percent.
<fixed_target_name>.passed: True means passed, false means failed, null means unavailable; settling also requires settled=true.
<fixed_target_name>.source: Saved verification field and aggregation used for this comparison.
<fixed_target_name>.reason: Why a check failed or was unavailable; empty when passed.

per_output_mse.<output_name>: MSE-only detail: full-window MSE of this controlled output.

<fixed_target_name>.settled: Settling-only detail: whether the settling time was actually achieved.
<fixed_target_name>.overshoot_meaningful: Overshoot-only detail: whether the reported overshoot has a valid interpretation.

best_params.Np: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future time steps predicted by MPC.
best_params.Nc: Best candidate selected across tuning: number of future control moves optimized by MPC.
Q: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly each state error is penalized.
R: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights deciding how strongly control-input use is penalized.
P: Best candidate selected across tuning: weights on state error at the end of the prediction horizon.
best_params.dt: Best candidate selected across tuning: effective sampling interval in seconds, resolved by the tuning summary.

tuning.best_cost: Best candidate across tuning: lowest composite cost found among eligible evaluated candidates.
tuning.best_mse: Best candidate across tuning: MSE from the candidate with the lowest composite cost; not necessarily the smallest MSE.
tuning.iterations: Final tuning iteration counter; not the number of simulation timesteps or total agent calls.
tuning.termination_reason: At the end of tuning: latest reason the Terminator requested a Juror review.
tuning.juror_verdict: At the end of tuning: latest Juror decision about acceptance or further tuning.

token_usage.simulated: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: whether these are generated mock counts and costs, rather than real API usage.
token_usage.prompt_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: total recorded input tokens.
token_usage.completion_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: total recorded output tokens.
token_usage.total_tokens: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input plus output tokens.
token_usage.call_count: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: number of recorded model calls.
token_usage.unparsed_calls: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded calls whose token counts could not be read.

<model_name>.prompt: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input tokens for this model.
<model_name>.completion: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded output tokens for this model.
<model_name>.total: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: recorded input plus output tokens for this model.

token_usage.cost_usd: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: estimated US-dollar cost of recorded tokens; synthetic in mock mode.
unpriced_models: Cumulative for the entire tuning run: model name without a price entry; its cost cannot be estimated.

tuning.completed: Whether the tuning workflow finished without a streaming exception; does not mean the controller achieved its target.

metrics.mse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared difference between actual and target values, over all states and times.
metrics.rmse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: square root of average squared tracking error over all states and times.
metrics.overshoot: Separate verification simulation with best_params: largest amount a state went past its target, divided by that state initial error.
metrics.overshoot_meaningful: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether any state has a constant target and a nonzero starting error, making overshoot calculable.
metrics.settling_time: Separate verification simulation with best_params: seconds until error became small and stayed small enough; if not settled, this is the duration-based fallback, not an achieved settling time.
metrics.settled: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error became small and passed the minimum-duration and hold checks.
metrics.is_stable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether error settled or did not grow significantly from the first to the last quarter; not a formal stability proof.
metrics.control_effort: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared applied input over all control steps; smaller means less input use.
metrics.oscillation_count: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of error sign changes for the state with the largest starting error.
per_state_mse: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average squared tracking error for one state, in state-name order.
per_state_overshoot: Separate verification simulation with best_params: overshoot fraction for one state, in state-name order; null if not calculable.
metrics.integral_abs_error: Separate verification simulation with best_params: absolute tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.
metrics.integral_sq_error: Separate verification simulation with best_params: squared tracking error accumulated over time, summed over all states.
per_state_iae: Separate verification simulation with best_params: absolute tracking error accumulated over time for one state, in state-name order.
per_state_ise: Separate verification simulation with best_params: squared tracking error accumulated over time for one state, in state-name order.
metrics.is_regulation: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether all state targets stayed constant throughout the simulation.

raw_result.trajectory_file: Path relative to this results JSON to the compressed NPZ containing all verification states, inputs, reference and times; null if unavailable. No samples are removed.

trajectory._description: Documentation only: the four arrays below are saved together in the NPZ file linked by trajectory_file, not inside the actual results JSON. All samples are kept for plotting, and metrics use the complete simulation.
states: Actual plant state value during verification with best_params. In the NPZ: states; rows are recorded times and columns are model states.
inputs: Applied control value during verification with best_params. In the NPZ: inputs; rows are control steps and columns are inputs. There may be one fewer row than states.
reference: Desired state value during verification with best_params. In the NPZ: reference; each row matches the corresponding states row.
times: Verification timestamp in seconds. In the NPZ: times; use it to plot states and reference, and times[:len(inputs)] to plot control inputs.

raw_result.success: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the response passed the settling check; not the success-rate score.
raw_result.unstable: Separate verification simulation with best_params: whether the simulator detected divergence or a state-bound violation.
raw_result.unstable_reason: Separate verification simulation with best_params: reason for detected divergence or a state-bound violation, if any.
raw_result.avg_solve_time: Separate verification simulation with best_params: average seconds spent solving one MPC optimization.
raw_result.steps: Verification with best_params: number of control steps completed.

solver_diagnostics.solved: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number of MPC optimizations reported as solved.
solver_diagnostics.solved_inaccurate: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number reported as solved with reduced accuracy.
solver_diagnostics.other: Separate verification simulation with best_params: number with any other recorded solver status.

outputs: Output state names used for verification output-specific MSE and task-scale summaries.

full: Verification with best_params: full-simulation MSE for one output, in verification.outputs order.

task_scale: Verification: mean squared gap between each output starting value and its reference over the full simulation; for a constant target this is the squared initial error.
verification.task_scale_basis: mse: task_scale is already mean-squared; do not square it again. Older unmarked RMS scales are converted once during finalization.
